title: Jeff Goldblum Plays Piano During Marrakech Festival Tribute
excerpt:
The actor received a career tribute and surprised the audience with live music.
Tilda Swinton introduced him as the festival revisited his landmark films.
body_md:
Jeff Goldblum received a career tribute at the Marrakech International Film Festival and marked the occasion with a live piano performance. A jazz musician as well as a film actor, he took his place at a grand piano after a montage celebrated his screen work across more than five decades.

Tilda Swinton, who appeared with Goldblum in The Grand Budapest Hotel, introduced the honoree and praised his singular presence in cinema. The retrospective montage included memorable performances from The Fly, Jurassic Park, Independence Day and Invasion of the Body Snatchers.

During his acceptance remarks, Goldblum thanked the filmmakers and collaborators who had supported him throughout his career. He reflected on the ability of films to connect audiences with experiences beyond their own and to illuminate shared humanity.

The festival is also screening The Big Chill, The Fly, Independence Day and Jurassic Park as part of its tribute program. The 2026 edition runs from November 20 through November 28.
